If  every  single  person  in  the  world  knew 
 about  your  business,  your  business  would 
 be  bigger  than  it  is  right  now.  If  every 
 single  person  in  the  world  knew  about 
 your  business,  then  you  would  have  the 
 talent  that  you  need  to  grow  that 
 business. 
 And  so  fundamentally,  whether  you're 
 supply  or  demand  constrained,  your 
 growth  is  being  limited  by  the  fact  that 
 you  are  irrelevant.  And  I  just  try  to 
 remember  this  is  like,  I  can  probably 
 solve  this  by  reaching  out  to  more 
 people,  by  making  more  stuff  for  the 
 people  that  I  want  to  serve,  and  by 
 advertising  more.
